integrity: Analytic proof supplied; 650 deterministic consistency checks passed. Published random-acceleration and active-particle ingredients are cited and not claimed as new; broad implicit-coverage risk remains.
scientific_limitations: Complete Poisson resetting with prescribed heading and zero reset velocity; fixed positive friction, propulsion and rotational diffusivity. Density far-tail holds after, not uniformly within, high-rate limit. Other resetting protocols and finite-rate tails not characterized.
title: Critical thermal-noise crossover and angular tails in inertial active resetting
